Robots Recreation

A Java desktop recreation of the classic Robots game built with Java Swing. The project focuses on object-oriented design, clean game logic, and a structured UI.

Overview

This project recreates the gameplay of the classic Robots game, where the player must survive while robots move toward them each turn. I used Java and Swing to build the interface and organize the game into manageable classes.

Technologies Used

  • Java
  • Java Swing
  • Object-Oriented Programming
  • Git/GitHub

What I Worked On

  • Game board logic
  • Robot movement behavior
  • Player controls and survival rules
  • UI layout using Swing
